real_world_references.title: Error when unsealing restored raft snapshot
Only first pod of stateful set enables after raft restore

expected_answer.root_cause: A backup-seeded follower carries a stale persisted CurrentTerm (and stale snapshot metadata) that predates a leadership change. When the leader sends an InstallSnapshot RPC, hashicorp/raft's raft.go::installSnapshot inspects the request term and the follower's persisted state, then streams bytes into a sink created by Vault's physical/raft/snapshot.go::BoltSnapshotStore.Create. The copy aborts (short read / size mismatch / term gating) and the sink is cancelled, so the restoreFuture is never dispatched to fsmMutateCh, and physical/raft/fsm.go::FSM.Restore (invoked by raft fsm.go::fsmRestoreAndMeasure) never executes. Without an applied snapshot, the follower cannot match the leader's last log term and transitions to candidate, raising its term and looping.
error_chain: SRE replaces failed follower and seeds /vault/raft from a backup that predates a recent leadership change
Follower starts and rejoins; persisted CurrentTerm is stale
Leader sends InstallSnapshot RPC to follower
hashicorp/raft raft.go::installSnapshot inspects req.Term vs persisted CurrentTerm and version gating
Vault physical/raft/snapshot.go::BoltSnapshotStore.Create produces a BoltSnapshotSink, io.Copy runs into the sink
Copy short-reads or term gating triggers; sink.Cancel() is called and the restoreFuture path is skipped
Without a successful restoreFuture on fsmMutateCh, raft fsm.go::fsmRestoreAndMeasure never invokes physical/raft/fsm.go::FSM.Restore
Follower's local state stays behind the leader's lastLogTerm/Index
Follower election timeout fires; it transitions to candidate, increments term, and loops
affected_components: Vault physical/raft snapshot store (physical/raft/snapshot.go, BoltSnapshotStore + BoltSnapshotSink)
Follower election / state machine (candidate transition path)
expected_answer.remediation: Three layered options: (1) Prune or quarantine snapshot files under physical/raft/snapshots/ on the seeded follower before bringing it online, so the leader's InstallSnapshot is the only source of truth; (2) Add an explicit term/index fence in the Vault BoltSnapshotSink Write/Close path that refuses to finalize a sink whose meta term is older than the local persisted CurrentTerm, surfacing a clear error instead of a silent short-read; (3) Document and tool the backup-seeded recovery flow to require a peers.json / raft state reset (e.g. via `vault operator raft remove-peer` followed by a fresh add) so the follower starts empty and lets the leader fully rebuild state.
